scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @eveops/web" "npm run start:dev -w @eveops/api" "npm run start:dev -w @eveops/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eveops/contracts && npm run build -w @eveops/operations && npm run build -w @eveops/api && npm run build -w @eveops/worker && npm run build -w @eveops/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages prisma/seed.ts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/operations/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
